# telnyx_porting_order_verification_codes (Data Source)

The verification codes of a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id id.

### Optional

- `filter_verified` (Boolean) Filter verification codes that have been verified or not
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_verification_codes` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_verification_codes))
